errors.evidence: The description states the markers for the 'SepLLM (n=64)' series are 'plus markers', but the plot shows them as vertical line segments.
The description states that the 'SepLLM (n=64)' series rises to about 100.1% at 2e8 TFLOPs, but the data point is exactly on the 100% grid line.
The description states that the 'SepLLM (n=128)' series finishes around 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs, but the data point is visibly lower, at approximately 99.6%.
The description states the 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' series starts at about 94.0%, but the data point is visibly below the 94% grid line, at approximately 93.9%.

The description states that the 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' series dips to roughly 98.5% at 5e8 TFLOPs, but the data point is visibly lower than the halfway mark between 98% and 99%, at approximately 98.3-98.4%.
